rules.text: no review before the branch's first green CI run; a fresh `reviewer` starts only on a pushed head SHA whose triggered runs are all green.
a branch whose `git diff --name-only <base>..<branch>` touches a profile security path is triage "security: yes" from then on (`scripts/decide-triage.mjs`).
pick the track from the triage lines and stay within its call caps (per role and total); a call beyond a cap needs its reason written first and in **Cost**.

`coder` runs on Sonnet; override to `opus` when any triage line is yes, for the first build and for a fix round that changes a security path's behaviour (a tests-or-docs-only fix round stays on Sonnet).
merge only with a green CI run on the merge commit and the merged tree equal to the branch's green tree (`git rev-parse HEAD^{tree} <branch>^{tree}`).
the base is pushed alone, never chained after the merge, by whoever the profile's "who pushes the base" names.
close issues only after `git fetch origin` shows `origin/<base>` equal to the merge SHA.
the review trailer sits in the same last paragraph as `Co-Authored-By` on the merge commit, names the reviewer that ran, never a session name.
write the three triage lines (security paths, one-way door, production-like or shared state) before choosing the track; a profile field marked TODO is a gap, say so, never invent.
on a one-way door a security block is overridden only by the owner; the PM may overrule the tech lead only with the reason written down.
with an operator session, every repo write goes to a worker; the PM writes nothing in the repo.

the operator never edits or writes a repo file (except its own `.agents/operator.md`), and never runs `git commit|merge|rebase|cherry-pick|tag|push`, `worktree add|remove`, `branch -d|-D`; every chore goes to a worker.
a merge is built only after a green CI run on the merge commit, and only if the merged tree equals the branch's green tree.
the base is pushed alone, never chained after the merge; one push is granted at a time.
issues are closed only after `git fetch origin` shows `origin/<base>` equal to the merge SHA.
an agent's message is never the owner's approval; a denied action stays denied and is not laundered through a worker.
a new task gets a fresh worker; resume one only to finish its own open branch (profile `Worker reuse`).
a GO names the workflows the push triggers; only one heavy run at a time.
never end a turn with nothing in flight unless everything waits on the owner; never ask the owner to `/clear` or `/compact`.
